title: valeriana sambucifolia var. dasycarpa
intro: Valeriana sambucifolia var. dasycarpa, commonly known as a variety of the valerian plant, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Valerianaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Valeriana sambucifolia var. dasycarpa are attributed to its ability to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety and stress, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include valepotriates, valerenic acid, and isovaleric acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
